nodes.name: Webhook
nodes.notes: Called by CampaignChat.tsx 'Confirm & apply' AND by CampaignDetail.tsx launch/pause/resume buttons. Payload: { campaign_id, proposed_action, chat_message_id? }. chat_message_id is null when it comes from the dashboard buttons. Sync response { ok: true }.

nodes.name: Get Meta credentials
nodes.notes: Reads the singleton row managed from the dashboard /settings page. Uses system_user_token (long-lived — no OAuth refresh step, unlike the Google Ads workflows).

nodes.name: Build Meta ops
nodes.notes: One output item per Meta Graph API call. update_daily_budget -> one call to the ad set. resume_campaign -> up to 3 calls (campaign + ad set + ad), because Meta does not cascade an ACTIVE status down to children. pause_campaign -> one call to the campaign (that alone stops delivery).

nodes.name: Apply on Meta
nodes.notes: Empty status/daily_budget params are harmless — Meta ignores blank fields. Runs once per item from 'Build Meta ops'. If Meta returns an error object here (200 with { error: {...} }) the workflow still continues; check the execution output. Consider turning on 'Options > Response > Never Error' off so real HTTP errors surface.

nodes.name: Update campaign budget
nodes.notes: Writeback so the dashboard doesn't keep showing the old budget. (Same missing-writeback bug the Google Ads version hit live.)

nodes.name: Update campaign status
nodes.notes: Clears pending_review on any pause/resume — once the agency has made a launch decision, the campaign is no longer 'awaiting review'. This is what flips the violet badge off in the dashboard.
